name: Luchshaya devushka leta 2022
source:
This is a collection of winning stories from the contest by [url=/p30094]Domaroshchiner[/url].
Here you will find short stories for every girl in Everlasting Summer. Well... almost every girl.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2846061768]Steam[/url]]
